description: Tasks 7-8: New mediaconvert-worker implementation and deletion of clip-worker, concat-worker, Dockerfiles, FFmpeg code.
steps: TASK 7 - mediaconvert-worker: Create lambdas/mediaconvert-worker/ with package.json (deps: @slide-first/shared-types workspace:*, @slide-first/core workspace:*, @aws-sdk/client-mediaconvert). Build script uses esbuild to bundle into single dist/index.js (external: @aws-sdk/*). Create src/index.ts implementing: (a) Read manifest from S3, (b) Build MediaConvert job JSON matching the verified template from design doc section 2.1 exactly - Role ARN from env var, AccelerationSettings DISABLED, TimecodeConfig ZEROBASED, Inputs array with one entry per page (AudioSelectors with ExternalAudioFileInput pointing to .wav, VideoGenerator with Duration=frameAlignedDurationMs, ImageInput, 30fps 1920x1080), OutputGroups with FILE_GROUP_SETTINGS, H264 QVBR 5Mbps, AAC 96kbps 48kHz stereo. (c) Submit job via MediaConvert CreateJob. (d) Poll/wait for completion. (e) Update manifest stages.video to done. Create src/job-builder.ts with buildMediaConvertJob() function that generates the job JSON. Create src/job-builder.test.ts unit test verifying the generated JSON structure matches section 2.1 for a 2-page input. Add vitest.config.ts and tsconfig files.

TASK 8 - Delete obsolete code: (a) Delete lambdas/clip-worker/ directory entirely. (b) Delete lambdas/concat-worker/ directory entirely. (c) Delete all Dockerfiles: lambdas/marp-render/Dockerfile, lambdas/polly-worker/Dockerfile, lambdas/clip-worker/Dockerfile, lambdas/concat-worker/Dockerfile. (d) Delete packages/renderer-ffmpeg/ directory entirely (FFmpeg command builders no longer needed). (e) Delete packages/renderer-port/ directory (abstract port for FFmpeg renderer no longer needed). (f) Remove references to renderer-ffmpeg and renderer-port from pnpm-workspace.yaml if listed, and from any package.json that depends on them. (g) Remove clip-worker and concat-worker from infra imports and construct usage. (h) Clean up any remaining ffmpeg/ffprobe string references in implementation code.
Update pnpm-workspace.yaml if needed (renderer-ffmpeg and renderer-port are under packages/* glob so they auto-resolve, but after deletion they just won't exist)
Run pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm test
Commit with message: 'feat: task 7-8 mediaconvert-worker, delete clip/concat workers and FFmpeg code'
acceptance_criteria: lambdas/mediaconvert-worker/dist/index.js exists as single bundled file after build
Job builder test passes verifying JSON matches section 2.1 template structure
No Dockerfile exists anywhere in the repo
No ffmpeg/ffprobe/pdftoppm/libreoffice strings in implementation code (grep returns empty)
pnpm build and pnpm test pass

findings: Task 7-8 completed. Build and all tests pass (8 mediaconvert-worker tests, 40 infra tests, 289 total tests across 12 packages). (2) Deleted: lambdas/clip-worker/, lambdas/concat-worker/, packages/renderer-ffmpeg/, packages/renderer-port/, all 4 Dockerfiles. (4) Infra tests updated to remove clip/concat assertions. (5) No ffmpeg/ffprobe strings remain in any source.
